title: A workbook sheet becomes its own table: the sheet receipt is accepted, and a few formula cells do not stop it
diagnosis: Rehearsal 2 run 2, s9-4a item 2: every sheet reaching keepSheet sent mediaType text/csv, which LargeUploadCreateSchema refuses (application/zip | application/octet-stream); the ZodError was stored as WORKBOOK_SHEET_UNAVAILABLE. 2 of 12 sheets asked Which header row because 11 and 2 body cells were marked.

changes.receipt: receiveSheetDerivative no longer overrides the media type; the sheet CSV goes as application/octet-stream like every other derivative from receiveLargeLayer, and is still probed as a CSV by its name.
changes.failure_codes: A non-AppError sheet failure keeps its kind: WORKBOOK_SHEET_RECEIPT (zod contract or receipt parse), WORKBOOK_SHEET_EXPORT (exporter process exit), WORKBOOK_SHEET_SECONDS_LIMIT (timeout, as before), else WORKBOOK_SHEET_UNAVAILABLE; each has plain sheet words.
changes.marked_cells: Marked body cells (formula with or without a stored result, error, no value, unsupported) up to 2 percent of occupied body cells: the profile counts them as occupied, neither text nor number; the exporter writes them empty and counts them; receipt and workbookSheet lineage carry markedCellsLeftEmpty; the sheet words add N formula or error cells left empty. A marked header cell or more than 2 percent refuses WORKBOOK_MARKED_CELLS_NOT_CSV as before. No cached or computed value is written.

inputs.good: generated test_only ODS: 100 headerless rows x 3 columns, 2 formula cells -> read, 2 left empty, CSV cells empty
inputs.difficult: generated test_only ODS with 15 formula cells (5 percent) -> still asks Which header row; generated xlsx with 2 and 10 uncached formulas of 200 cells; public ODS and DfE calculator workbook unchanged

tests.regression: a headerless sheet with a few formula cells is received through the real receipt contract: LargeOriginalService.create parses each sheet request (storage stub stops it after the parse); with text/csv restored it fails with WORKBOOK_SHEET_UNAVAILABLE
tests.codes: a sheet failure that is not an AppError keeps a code naming its kind
tests.lineage: PGlite ods/xlsx sheet CSV tests assert workbookSheet.markedCellsLeftEmpty (run with S13X_PGLITE_MODULE set: 8 pass)

checks.node scripts/test-server.mjs: exit 0: files 144, tests 1625, pass 1607, fail 0, skip 18 (the before run overlapped the edits and is not a clean baseline)
checks.openapi --check: exit 1: docs/api/source-pins.json stale for the changed producer (expected on a task branch)

gaps: Header-based sheets also read with at most 2 percent marked body cells now; no rerun of the rehearsal workbook (no runtime in this task).
